queries.query: How did Darius's Q cooldown change in patch 26.21?
queries.ideal_answer: In patch 26.21, Darius's Q (Decimate) cooldown changed from 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 5s to 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 4s: only the rank-5 cooldown was reduced, by one second. Riot buffed him so he can swing his axe more often in sustained fights.

queries.query: What changes did Locke's Q get in patch 26.22?
queries.ideal_answer: In patch 26.22, Locke's Q (Ritual Nails) was nerfed: Stack Bonus Damage went from 18 / 26 / 34 / 42 / 50 to 15 / 22 / 29 / 36 / 43, and Maximum Stack Damage from 75.6 / 109.2 / 142.8 / 176.4 / 210 to 63 / 92.4 / 121.8 / 151.2 / 180.6.

queries.query: Why did Riot nerf Thresh in patch 26.22, and what was changed?
queries.ideal_answer: Despite a previous nerf, Thresh remained at the very top of the support pecking order for top-tier players, so Riot nerfed him again in 26.22: base Attack Damage went from 56 to 54, and R (The Box) damage from 250 / 400 / 550 (+100% AP) to 200 / 350 / 500 (+100% AP).

queries.query: In which patch did Draven's base Attack Damage change, and why?
queries.ideal_answer: Draven's base Attack Damage went from 62 to 64 in patch 26.19. Since all bot laners received significantly more gold income from role quests, Draven's gold advantage from Adoration stacks had lost impact, so Riot buffed his early-game damage.

queries.query: What changed for Mel in patch 26.22?
queries.ideal_answer: Mel received a midscope update in 26.22 that moves power from early game to scaling. Base stats changed (e.g. Health 640 + 99/level → 590 + 107/level). Her passive's bonus damage per bolt at low levels was lowered (8 → 4 minimum). Q (Radiant Volley) first-hit damage was cut to 60 (+25% AP) while multi-hit damage rose, and it now refunds cooldown when it hits a champion. W (Rebuttal) was reworked into a nova that destroys enemy projectiles and shields, grants move speed and retaliates against destroyed missiles. E (Solar Snare) root duration now scales with distance. R (Golden Eclipse) cooldown went from 120 / 100 / 80 to 120 / 90 / 60 seconds.

queries.query: How did Locke's W change in patches 26.21 and 26.22?
queries.ideal_answer: In 26.21, Soul Ignition's mana cost rose from 50 / 55 / 60 / 65 / 70 to 60 / 65 / 70 / 75 / 80, the grey health stored based on current health went from 40 - 200 to 20 - 200, and the current health store went from 150 - 450 to 100 - 500 (+60% AP). In 26.22, its duration was reduced from 6s to 5s.

queries.query: What did patch 26.22 change about Doran's Bow, and why?
queries.ideal_answer: Doran's Bow's Attack Damage was reduced from 8 to 7 in patch 26.22. Riot considered it slightly but clearly too strong: marksmen expected to lean towards Doran's Blade were almost exclusively buying Doran's Bow.

queries.query: Which champions were added to League Classic in patch 26.21?
queries.ideal_answer: Patch 26.21 brought four classic-era champions to League Classic: Mordekaiser (with his 2010-2015 kit), Yorick, Hecarim and Lucian.

queries.query: How was Bel'Veth changed in Arena in patch 26.21?
queries.ideal_answer: In Arena in patch 26.21, Bel'Veth was nerfed: her Q (Void Surge) Attack Damage ratio went from 105% to 95%, and her R (Endless Banquet) bonus Attack Damage ratio per stack from 1% to 0.5%.

queries.query: When does TFT move to its own standalone client, and what happens to TFT cosmetics in League?
queries.ideal_answer: TFT moves to its own standalone client starting November 4th, 2026. Existing TFT cosmetics remain usable in League; the first TFT-only Little Legends arrive on December 1st, and December 15th marks the full separation of TFT cosmetics, including emotes and icons.

queries.query: What are the champion balance changes in patch 26.23?
queries.ideal_answer: The available patch notes only cover patches 26.15 to 26.22, so there is no information about the balance changes in patch 26.23.

queries.query: What is Locke's win rate in patch 26.22?
queries.ideal_answer: The patch notes do not report win rates. They only state that Riot considers Locke still clearly too strong for players who have mastered him, especially in the early game, which is why his Q and W were nerfed in 26.22.
